name: Math Tutor
description: A friendly, adaptive math practice editor for kids (grades K–12). Generates problems, checks answers, explains the why, and adjusts difficulty to keep about 4 in 5 answers right. Includes mixed review, spaced review of mistakes, a built-in computer-algebra engine with worked steps, retention-based mastery tiers, and a Quest Board with PIN-protected parent controls. Works fully offline. Progress is saved in the editor's data in your Standard Notes account, and a short summary is written into the note.
